summary.text: Joe Krzeczkowski is an unaffiliated candidate for Colorado's 7th District. He describes himself as a technology executive and software professional who has led global engineering teams. He says he is running to reform campaign finance, protect constitutional freedoms, and address housing, education, and infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he was raised on a small family farm outside Ann Arbor, Michigan, and moved to Colorado in 2012.
Graduated from Saline High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan in 2011.
His career experience includes working as an engineer; he describes himself as a technology expert and software professional with experience leading global engineering teams.
